message.content: Production fell over at 3am. The API stopped accepting connections and the database showed hundreds of idle clients.
The pool exhaustion trace points at the report endpoint: it checks out a connection, streams rows, and the error path when the client disconnects never releases the connection back to the pool.
How do we keep one bad endpoint from starving the whole service again?

Two changes. The report handler now releases in a finally block so every path returns the connection. And the pool has an idle-timeout reaper plus a max-checkout duration, so a leaked connection is reclaimed instead of held forever.
